posts.title: Welcome to the lab
posts.excerpt: Stories, tech notes, and project logs — written in public, edited when the compile finishes.
posts.body:
## Why this exists

This blog is my public notebook: **stories**, **thoughts on new tech**, and **project logs** — things I've shipped, things I'm building, and things still living in the backlog.

Expect a mix of:

- Hardware verification notes (SystemVerilog, UVM, FPGA)
- Software and product build write-ups
- Occasional weekend tangents that somehow turn into systems thinking

## How it works

Posts live as structured data on this site. I write them from the admin desk when something is worth saying out loud.

If you're here from the portfolio — welcome. Stay for the builds.

posts.title: Hardware and software on the same desk
posts.excerpt: Why I refuse to pick one side of the stack — and how that shows up in the work.
posts.body:
## Both sides, same engineer

Most people ask me to pick: silicon or software. I don't.

One week it's a constrained-random UVM bench and coverage closure. The next it's a Kotlin Android product, a Dockerized web app, or an ESP32 on the bench.

### What that buys you

- Better instincts about where bugs actually live
- Respect for timing, power, and latency — not just "make it pretty"
- Products that feel like systems, not demos

I'll keep posting project notes here as they leave the lab.
